title: Unverified: the user 'Ranjan' who saved $80 on a hotel booking
titleZh: 未证实：省下 80 美元酒店房费的用户「Ranjan」
summary: A circulated case describes a user named Ranjan who had a Hilton booking on Booking.com; a family discount code email from his uncle had been missed, and Instinct proactively scanned the mailbox, told him the existing booking could be $80 cheaper with a 24-hour cancellation window, and after he approved, cancelled and rebooked.
summaryZh: 流传的案例称：用户 Ranjan 在 Booking.com 上有希尔顿预订，叔叔发来的家族折扣码邮件被漏看；Instinct 主动扫描邮箱，告知现有预订用该折扣码可便宜 $80 且还有 24 小时取消窗口，经其批准后取消并重新预订。
background: This case is used to illustrate proactivity: the value is that the user never even thought to look. That is a meaningful product claim, which is exactly why it needs a source.
backgroundZh: 该案例被用来展示「主动性」：价值在于用户压根没想到要去查。这是个有分量的产品主张，也正因如此才更需要来源。
outcome: No source could be found for this story. Instinct itself is real — a proactively scanning personal assistant founded by Noah Shinn, covered by Fortune and Fox News in late September 2026 — but the named user, the $80 figure and the booking details are untraceable.
outcomeZh: 未能找到该故事的任何来源。Instinct 产品本身真实——由 Noah Shinn 创立、以主动扫描为卖点的个人助理，Fortune 与 Fox News 在 2026 年 9 月下旬均有报道——但具名用户、$80 数字与预订细节均无从追溯。
keyFact: The story of a user named Ranjan saving $80 on a Hilton booking through Instinct has no traceable source, although the Instinct product and its proactive email-scanning design are independently documented as of September 2026.
keyFactZh: 「用户 Ranjan 通过 Instinct 在希尔顿预订上省下 $80」这一故事没有可追溯来源；不过截至 2026 年 9 月，Instinct 产品及其主动扫描邮箱的设计确实有独立报道。
debunks: Original claim: Instinct detected a missed family discount code email and rebooked a Booking.com Hilton reservation to save $80 within a 24-hour cancellation window. Reality: no source could be located for this user story.
debunksZh: 原说法：Instinct 发现被漏看的家族折扣码邮件，在 24 小时取消窗口内重新预订 Booking.com 的希尔顿订单，省下 $80。实情：该用户故事找不到任何来源。
